part.knightFork.title: Knight fork
part.knightFork.summary: The knight jumps and attacks two pieces at once; the fork works when a single move cannot save both.
ex.kf.le0GY: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kf.le0GY.hint: Look for a knight check that also attacks an undefended black piece.
ex.kf.le0GY.solution: 13.Nxf6+! captures the pawn with check to the king on e8 and attacks the bishop on g4. After 13...Ke7, 14.Nxg4 captures the bishop.
ex.kf.JMggH: Play as White and find the best move. The black queen is on d3, deep in your camp.
ex.kf.JMggH.hint: Look for a jump of the knight on f3 with check.
ex.kf.JMggH.solution: 14.Ne5+! checks the king on f7 and attacks the queen on d3. After 14...Kf8, 15.Nxd3 captures the queen.
ex.kf.85qZg: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kf.85qZg.hint: Look for a jump of the knight on d4 with check.
ex.kf.85qZg.solution: 16...Ne2+! checks the king on g1 and attacks the queen on c3. After 17.Kh1, 17...Nxc3 captures the queen.
ex.kf.EA7M7: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kf.EA7M7.hint: The fork here has no check: look for the square that attacks the queen and the rook.
ex.kf.EA7M7.solution: 28...Nd3! attacks the queen on f4 and the rook on e1. After 29.Qe3, which saves the queen, 29...Nxe1 captures the rook.
ex.kf.TMnM9: Play as White and find the best move. The black king is on f6 and the black rook on f2.
ex.kf.TMnM9.hint: Look for a knight jump from c3 with check.
ex.kf.TMnM9.solution: 46.Ne4+! checks the king on f6 and attacks the rook on f2. After 46...Kf7, 47.Nxf2 captures the rook.
ex.kf.VO2bH: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kf.VO2bH.hint: The white queen guards the fork square. Check whether it can really capture the knight.
ex.kf.VO2bH.solution: 15...Nd3+! checks the king on e1 and attacks the bishop on f4. If the queen takes the knight, the rook on d8 takes the queen. After 16.Kf1, 16...Nxf4 captures the bishop.
ex.kf.A2Yd6: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.kf.A2Yd6.hint: The fork here has no check: look for the square that attacks the queen and the bishop.
ex.kf.A2Yd6.solution: 16...Na5! attacks the queen on b3 and the bishop on b7. After 17.Qb2, which saves the queen, 17...Nxb7 captures the bishop.
ex.kf.8fsCM: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kf.8fsCM.hint: Look for a knight check and see who guards the square: a defender that captures and loses its piece saves nothing.
ex.kf.8fsCM.solution: 24.Nc7+! checks the king on d5 and attacks the rook on a8. If the rook on c8 takes the knight, the rook on c1 takes the rook. After 24...Kd6, 25.Nxa8 captures the rook.
ex.kf.zDvLA: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.kf.zDvLA.hint: The black king and the black queen are one jump away from the same square.
ex.kf.zDvLA.solution: 12.Nf4+! checks the king on e6 and attacks the queen on d5. After 12...Kf7, 13.Nxd5 captures the queen.
part.doubleAttack.title: Double attack
part.doubleAttack.summary: The queen, rook and bishop also hit two targets at once; the double attack works when the arrival square is safe.
ex.da.YSeDl: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.da.YSeDl.hint: Look for a queen check that also attacks an undefended black piece.
ex.da.YSeDl.solution: 37.Qg8+! checks the king on c8 and attacks the rook on e6. After 37...Kc7, 38.Qxe6 captures the rook.
ex.da.JPGAP: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.da.JPGAP.hint: Look for a bishop check that also attacks the white rook.
ex.da.JPGAP.solution: 39...Be4+! checks the king on g2 and attacks the rook on a8. After 40.Kf2, 40...Bxa8 captures the rook.
ex.da.rUEH7: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.da.rUEH7.hint: Look for a rook check that also attacks the white knight.
ex.da.rUEH7.solution: 49...Rd4+! checks the king on d1 and attacks the knight on d5. After 50.Ke2, 50...Rxd5 captures the knight.
ex.da.De07v: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.da.De07v.hint: The white rook on h1 is undefended.
ex.da.De07v.solution: 37...Qe4+! checks the king on b1 and attacks the rook on h1. After 38.Kc1, 38...Qxh1+ captures the rook with check.
ex.da.dQjwz: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.da.dQjwz.hint: The double attack here has no check: look for the bishop square that reaches both rooks.
ex.da.dQjwz.solution: 48...Bd5! attacks the rook on e4 and the rook on b7, without check. After 49.Rc7, which saves one rook, 49...Bxe4 captures the other.
ex.da.Sqwy5: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.da.Sqwy5.hint: The black rook on d8 is undefended.
ex.da.Sqwy5.solution: 30.Qh4+! checks the king on h6 and attacks the rook on d8. After 30...Kg6, 31.Qxd8 captures the rook.
ex.da.iHkKF: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.da.iHkKF.hint: The two black bishops are on the same rank. Look for the rook square that attacks both.
ex.da.iHkKF.solution: 22.Rd3! attacks the bishop on c3 and the bishop on f3, without check. After 22...Be5, which saves one bishop, 23.Rxf3 captures the other.
ex.da.Vjxbg: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.da.Vjxbg.hint: There is a check that attacks two pieces. If the opponent captures on the arrival square, see who recaptures.
ex.da.Vjxbg.solution: 13.Nc7+! checks the king on e8 and attacks the rook on a8. After 13...Qxc7, 14.Rxc7 captures the queen, because the rook on c1 defends c7.
ex.da.qnXsk: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.da.qnXsk.hint: Look for a check that attacks two pieces and see who defends the arrival square.
ex.da.qnXsk.solution: 30...Nf2+! checks the king on h1 and attacks the rook on d1. After 31.Qxf2, 31...Qxf2 captures the queen, because the queen on e3 defends f2.
part.hangingPiece.title: Hanging piece
part.hangingPiece.summary: Before capturing, count attackers and defenders: take the hanging piece, and enter an exchange only for a profit.
ex.hp.LGRr9: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.hp.LGRr9.hint: Look for a white piece with no defender.
ex.hp.LGRr9.solution: 35...Qxa1! captures the hanging bishop on a1: no white piece defends the square.
ex.hp.KzHRQ: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.hp.KzHRQ.hint: Look for a white piece with no defender.
ex.hp.KzHRQ.solution: 20...Qxc5! captures the white queen, which had no defender. The side to move captures first.
ex.hp.PBbZd: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.hp.PBbZd.hint: Look for a black piece with no defender.
ex.hp.PBbZd.solution: 8.Bxe5! captures the hanging knight on e5: no black piece defends the square.
ex.hp.K04xI: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.hp.K04xI.hint: Look for a white piece with no defender.
ex.hp.K04xI.solution: 26...Rxc6! captures the hanging knight on c6: no white piece defends the square.
ex.hp.Du1QP: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.hp.Du1QP.hint: Look for a black piece with no defender. Then count the exchange Black offers.
ex.hp.Du1QP.solution: 22.Qxc5! captures the hanging knight on c5. After 22...Rxf3, which captures the defended knight, 23.gxf3 recaptures: in the exchange, Black gave a rook for a knight.
ex.hp.8SuZ4: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.hp.8SuZ4.hint: Look for a white piece with no defender and check White's reply.
ex.hp.8SuZ4.solution: 39...Rxd3! captures the hanging bishop on d3. After 40.Rc8+, 40...Kh7 steps out of check, and Black stays a piece up.
ex.hp.jjnzy: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.hp.jjnzy.hint: Look for a black piece with no defender and check Black's reply.
ex.hp.jjnzy.solution: 39.Rxc5! captures the hanging rook on c5. After 39...Rxe2+, 40.Kxe2 recaptures: White is left with rook against bishop.
ex.hp.e7jIm: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.hp.e7jIm.hint: There is a capture that also attacks other pieces. See what is left after the reply.
ex.hp.e7jIm.solution: 18.Nxc8+! captures the hanging rook on c8 with check and attacks the queen on b6. After 18...Kxf7, 19.Nxb6 captures the queen.
ex.hp.ZMu5X: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.hp.ZMu5X.hint: There is a capture that also attacks other pieces. See what is left after the reply.
ex.hp.ZMu5X.solution: 13...Qxc3! captures the hanging knight on c3 and attacks the knight on c6, also undefended. After 14.Bd4, which attacks the queen, 14...Qxc6 captures the other knight.
t1.pnFLV: Play as White and find the best move.
t1.pnFLV.hint: Count the attackers and defenders of each piece before you choose the move.
t1.pnFLV.solution: 14.dxe5! captures the rook on e5 with the pawn. After 14...Qxd3, 15.Bxd3 recaptures the queen, and the captured rook is pure profit.
t1.t98e5: Play as White and find the best move.
t1.t98e5.hint: Before you move, check the checks, the captures and the undefended pieces.
t1.t98e5.solution: 43.Nd4+! checks the king on f5 and attacks the rook on b5. After 43...Ke4, 44.Nxb5 captures the rook.
t1.qNmln: Play as Black and find the best move.
t1.qNmln.hint: Before you move, check the checks, the captures and the undefended pieces.
t1.qNmln.solution: 15...Bxc3+! captures the pawn with check to the king on e1 and attacks the rook on a1. After 16.Kf1, 16...Bxa1 captures the rook.
t1.KTDgw: Play as White and find the best move.
t1.KTDgw.hint: Look for moves that make two threats at once and check whether the opponent can meet both.
t1.KTDgw.solution: 48.Nc6+! checks the king on e5 and attacks the rook on d8. After 48...Kd6, which attacks the knight, 49.Nxd8 captures the rook.
t1.zvvGr: Play as Black and find the best move.
t1.zvvGr.hint: Look for moves that make two threats at once and check whether the opponent can meet both.
t1.zvvGr.solution: 21...Rd2! attacks the bishops on b2 and e2, and neither has a defender. It is not check, but one move cannot save both: after 22.Bc4, which moves the bishop off e2, 22...Rxb2 captures the other.
t1.MYCne: Play as Black and find the best move.
t1.MYCne.hint: Count the attackers and defenders of each piece before you choose the move.
t1.MYCne.solution: 12...Qxh4! captures the hanging knight on h4. After 13.Bxe6, which captures the bishop on e6, 13...fxe6 recaptures, and the captured knight is pure profit.
t1.KKdDO: Play as White and find the best move.
t1.KKdDO.hint: Before you occupy a square, check who attacks it, who defends it and what a capture there costs.
t1.KKdDO.solution: 24.Bg5! attacks the queen on h4 and the rook on f6. The black queen can capture the bishop, but the queen on g2 defends g5: after 24...Qxg5, 25.Qxg5 captures the queen.
t1.KJha4: Play as Black and find the best move.
t1.KJha4.hint: Before you move, check the checks, the captures and the undefended pieces.
t1.KJha4.solution: 17...Ne2+! checks the king on g1 and attacks the queen on g3. After 18.Kh2, 18...Nxg3 captures the queen.
t1.tINkk: Play as White and find the best move.
t1.tINkk.hint: Count the attackers and defenders of each piece before you choose the move.
t1.tINkk.solution: 23.Bxf4! captures the rook on f4. It has one defender, the knight on h5, and two attackers, the bishop and the rook on f1: after 23...Nxf4, 24.Rxf4 recaptures, and White wins rook and knight for the bishop.
t1.Sx2Mp: Play as Black and find the best move.
t1.Sx2Mp.hint: Look for moves that make two threats at once and check whether the opponent can meet both.
t1.Sx2Mp.solution: 26...Nc2! attacks the rooks on a1 and e1. It is not check, and the rooks have defenders, but one move cannot take both out of the attack: after 27.Rf1, 27...Nxa1 captures the rook. If 28.Rxa1, Black has won a rook for a knight.
t1.7ebT9: Play as Black and find the best move.
t1.7ebT9.hint: Count the defenders of each piece and check what is left after the reply.
t1.7ebT9.solution: 22...Qxe1+! captures the hanging knight on e1 with check and attacks the bishop on e2. After 23.Rf1, which blocks the check and attacks the queen, 23...Qxe2 captures the bishop.
t1.IH7iZ: Play as White and find the best move.
t1.IH7iZ.hint: Before you occupy a square, check who attacks it, who defends it and what a capture there costs.
t1.IH7iZ.solution: 34.Ne7+! checks the king on g8, and the king has no square: the queen on h4 covers h7 and h8, and f7, f8 and g7 are occupied. Only the black queen can capture the knight, but the queen on h4 defends e7: after 34...Qxe7, 35.Qxe7 captures the queen.
